Jharkhand Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board(JCECEB ) conducts the Jharkhand Ayush Counselling for Ayush Courses. To participate in the counselling, the eligible NEET-UG candidates must register with the Jharkhand Ayush Counselling official website at https://jceceb.jharkhand.gov.in/. Admission to the courses is solely based on the NEET-UG scores of the current year.

Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy are the ayush courses, for which the counselling is undergone. However, Madhya Pradesh offers private and government homeopathy colleges recognized by the National Commission for Homeopathy for the Jharkhand counselling, as currently, there are no BAMS colleges in Jharkhand accepting students for the program through counselling.

Jharkhand reserves its 85% seats for domicile students of Madhya Pradesh under the State Quota. Students from other states/ non-domicile students can also apply to BHMS colleges in Jharkhand under the 15% seats of All India Quota (AIQ), conducted by the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee ( AACCC).

sections.heading: Jharkhand Ayush Counselling Process- State Quota

content.text: Here is the step-by-step guide for the process involved in the Jharkhand Ayush Counselling under the state quota.

items: Visit the Jharkhand Ayush Counselling official website, https://jceceb.jharkhand.gov.in/, and fill out the application form with the necessary personal and academic details.
Upload photo, signature, and additional necessary documents as instructed.
Pay the registration/ counselling fees and submit the application form.
The merit list is published on the JCECEB website with the ranks according to your NEET-UG scores.
Candidates must provide their preference for colleges during the choice filling session and lock their choices.
Seats are allotted to colleges based on the NEET rank of the candidates, the reservation policy, the choices of colleges, and the seat matrix of colleges.
The allotment results are published on the official website. Log in to the portal to view and download the Provisional Allotment Letter.
The candidates must attend the document verification at the designated center with the relevant original documents and get them verified.
Report to the allotted college, produce the original certificates, and make payment of the fees to complete the admission process.

The whole JCECEB Counselling process is carried out in multiple allotments (Round 1/ Round 2/ Round 3/ Stray Vacancy Round), with each round starting from registration to admission to the allotted college.

Candidates who are not allotted seats in any rounds, or did not join the allotted college, or gave their willingness to upgrade the seats, can participate in the subsequent rounds. Fresh candidates in each round have to register with fee payment for the allotment.
The Stray vacancy Round will be conducted for the vacant seats after allotment of the previous 3 rounds.
Fresh choices are filled in each round, and there are no restrictions on the number of preferences. Candidates can fill as many preferences as possible.

sections.heading: Jharkhand Ayush Counselling Process- All India Quota (AIQ)

content.text: Here is the step-by-step guide for the process involved in the Jharkhand Ayush Counselling under the All India quota (AIQ).

items: Register with the official website of AACCC at aaccc.gov.in by providing the necessary personal and academic details and uploading the relevant certificates and documents.
Make payment of the counselling fee and register successfully.
During the choice filling session, candidates need to choose the state and colleges according to their preference. It is mandatory to lock the choices before the last date.
Seats are allotted in multiple rounds- Round 1/ Round 2/ Mop-Up Round/ Stray Vacancy Round.
In each round, participants need to register and fill in the choices of colleges. Already registered candidates any any rounds do not register again for the next round.
Allotment is made based on the NEET-UG score, reservation policy, seat availability, and choice of colleges by the candidates.
The Allotment Result is published on the official website of AACCC. Log in to the portal with your credentials and download the Allotment Letter.
Candidates who are allotted seats must report to the respective college and submit the necessary original certificates and documents for verification.
Make payment of the prescribed college fee within the time frame provided to confirm seat at the college.

Jharkhand Ayush Counselling Process- State Quota

Fresh choices are filled in each round, and there are no restrictions on the number of preferences. Candidates can fill as many preferences as possible.
